The source defines the Hero V arm relationship but does not change the deferred second V's role, derivation rule, or development prerequisite.

The source changes the conceptual meaning and arm relationship of the Hero V, not the deferred champagne-metal material treatment or its design hierarchy.
The source concerns the Hero V's two-arm progression and does not change the deferred construction or visual language of the remaining wordmark letterforms.
